entry.author: Ministry for Ethnic Communities
entry.summary:
New Zealand Government ministers, Hon. Nicola Willis, Minister of Finance, Hon. Mark Mitchell, Minister for Ethnic Communities, and Hon. Chris Penk, Minister for Small Business and Manufacturing, outline how the Government is backing ethnic entrepreneurs through regulatory reform, investment attraction and innovation support.

'From red tape to red carpet' was a panel session at the Ministry for Ethnic Communities' business symposium, Ethnic Xchange 2025 (EX25).
